tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The brand colour, taken from the logo file (junkbox-original-amber.png). Logo tile, photo backdrops, posts, buttons, stickers. Text on amber is on-amber. Never text on surface in Light (1.9:1).

tokens.name: amber-press
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of amber buttons; on-amber text stays on it.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text, line art and the logo on amber (8.6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The logo's black, taken from the logo file. Line art, the ink tile, dark posts, menu boards. Constant across themes.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ink (16.3:1). amber also reads on ink (8.6:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. White, like the logo's own ground; ink in Dark.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed bands: menu category rows, footer.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body on surface, surface-sunk and surface-raised (12.9:1 or better in both themes). Not on amber: use on-amber.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Ingredients, weights, captions on surface, surface-sunk and surface-raised (6.2:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges. Borders that must be seen use text or text-muted.

tokens.name: tag
tokens.usage: Price tag fill on surface and surface-raised: ink in Light, amber in Dark so it always stands off the page.

tokens.name: on-tag
tokens.usage: Price text on tag (16.3:1 Light, 8.6:1 Dark).

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: Only the ЛЮТО tag text and border, for spicy items like Hot Bandolero. Text on surface and surface-raised (6.5:1 Light, 6.2:1 Dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset (16.3:1 Light, 8.6:1 Dark on surface).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per poster, post or story. Caps. Item names and short headlines. Stand-in for the logo's hand lettering.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Post headline, menu board item name.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Item name on a menu card.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: Wide-tracked caps, as in the logo's tagline. Category lines, labels, post sublines.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Бриош питка, телешко кюфте Блек Ангъс, зрял чедър.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Домашни кисели краставички, бургер сос, айсберг.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices. Comma decimal, a space, then €.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tags; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between name and description in a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Post margins at preview scale.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Logo tiles, posts, photo frames: square, like the logo files.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, price tags, cards.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Round stickers and the avatar crop only.
